changes_made.explanation: All variants refer to Accuracy metric. Simplified to base form 'Accuracy' as per normalization rules.
Removed PRM models since they are the core contribution being evaluated, not used as judges. Simplified 'Best-of-N scoring' to 'Best-of-N'. Normalized model name formatting.

guideline: Physicians evaluated top-scoring notes from Best-of-2000 selections in randomized blinded studies with at least three physicians per experiment
Physicians evaluated top-scoring notes from Best-of-2000 selections in randomized blinded studies with at least three physicians per experiment
- Physicians evaluated the top-scoring notes to select the preferred one.
Physicians evaluated the top-scoring notes for overall quality and alignment with clinical standards.

Each experiment was conducted in a randomized and blinded manner, involving at least three physicians. The top-ranking notes from their Best-of-2000 selections were then submitted for physician review.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated multiple guideline descriptions into a single comprehensive statement. Added 'note quality' criterion based on paper description of evaluating overall quality.

overall_notes: Paper focuses on clinical note generation using process-supervised reward models. Extraction was generally accurate but contained some duplicates and variations that needed normalization. The PRM (LLaMA-3.1 8B) is the main model being evaluated, not used as a judge against other models.
